# origincloud_iam_role_binding (Resource)

One role granted to one member, organization-wide or in one project. A binding can't be changed: delete it and create another.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `member` (String) The full name of who holds the role: a user, `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/users/{user}`, one of the organization's service accounts, `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/organizations/{organization}/serviceAccounts/{service_account}`, or a platform service agent, `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/serviceAgents/{service_agent}`. A pending binding's member is `user:{email}`, the address it was granted to, until it becomes active. Changing it replaces the role binding.
- `organization` (String) The organization the role binding is in. Changing it replaces the role binding.
- `role` (String) The full name of the role granted, `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/roles/{role}`. Changing it replaces the role binding.

### Optional

- `project` (String) The full name of the project the binding is limited to, one of the organization's: `//resourcemanager.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}`. Empty for a binding on the whole organization, which covers every project in it. Changing it replaces the role binding.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) When the binding was created. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `creator` (String) The full name of who created the binding: `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/users/{user}`, `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/organizations/{organization}/serviceAccounts/{service_account}`, `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/serviceAgents/{service_agent}` for a platform service agent, or `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/services/{service}` for a change the platform made itself.
- `id` (String) The role binding's full resource name, `//iam.origincloudapis.eu/organizations/{organization}/roleBindings/{role_binding}`: what an argument that refers to the role binding takes. `name` is the relative name, without the host.
- `name` (String) The binding's resource name. A pending binding keeps its name when it becomes active.
- `state` (String) Whether the binding grants its role yet. One of `ACTIVE`, `PENDING`.
